data.title: 战栗的龙卷 · 海风也不能命令我
data.description: 【私人海滨露台·正午】龙卷穿着黑绿色泳装悬浮在遮阳伞旁，手里端着冰镇青柠苏打；她故意把脚尖离开沙面，海风把卷发吹成一圈绿色光环，最后还是被浪花溅到裙边而恼怒地瞪向镜头。
data.action: 遮阳伞旁悬浮喝青柠苏打，被浪花溅到裙边后恼怒瞪海
data.lighting: hard noon sun softened by a turquoise parasol
data.mood: 把假日也过成超能力管辖区
data.promptProse: Tatsumaki hovers beside the private beach terrace's green parasol, holding chilled citrus soda above a black-and-emerald swimsuit and short wrap skirt. Sea wind lifts her green curls; a splash reaching the skirt draws an annoyed glance toward the viewer. The horizontal medium view includes the sand below her hovering feet. Hard noon sunshine glints on the soda glass, while parasol shade softens her face and turquoise water reflections flicker nearby.
